C1316.title: Singapore IT Service Firm Hit by AiTM Phishing Attack Bypassing MFA
C1316.summary: In October 2025, Blackpanda incident response handled an AiTM phishing attack against a Singapore IT services company. Attackers used adversary-in-the-middle phishing to steal credentials and bypass MFA, compromising corporate mailbox accounts. They later accessed corporate email, registered a malicious Azure AD application, and launched phishing campaigns to more than 500 recipients.
